name: Netorase Onsen Ryokou ~Kareshi no Hata de Deatta Bakari no Tanin bou ni iki Kurui~
original_name: 寝取らせ温泉旅行 ～彼氏の傍で出会ったばかりの他人棒にイキ狂い～
source:
Miho Mamiya, who aspires to become a teacher, is dating her childhood friend, Kento Tanabe.
But Miho has been harboring a secret frustration for many years.
—Sex with Kento doesn’t feel good.
Because of her shy nature, she hadn’t confided in him, but Kento had begun to suspect that Miho might be unhappy.
While Kento was struggling with this embarrassing personal dilemma, he was drinking alone at a bar—almost as if to drown his sorrows—when Naohiro Asagi struck up a conversation with him.
Over drinks, Kento inadvertently confides his sensitive dilemma.
“Is she satisfied or not? Should I sleep with her to find out?”
At first, he’s taken aback and refuses… but he wants to get to the bottom of it.
And if Miho does enjoy it, it’ll be a learning experience for him, too.
Persuaded by Naohiro, who offers sincere advice, he agrees.
And so, a plan is proposed for a four-day, three-night hot spring trip where he’ll let Naohiro sleep with his girlfriend.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01006023.html/]dlsite[/url]]
